race.comment: Not much winning has been done by these lately. VERIFIER (7) is firmly in that camp after going under by only a long neck at this track, where he again produced a late surge after beginning slowly. His record around 2400m is good with one win and two placings from three starts at the distance, and if he jumps cleanly he can atone. LEGEND BEAST (1) brings the strongest higher-grade staying reference, dropping from a BM70 second at Warrnambool where he was run down late over 3100m. Will be strong late. MOTIVER (5) comes back from BM70 staying races, returns to a proven distance range and gets Dean Yendall back, so the setup gives him a genuine rebound platform. MILADY (12) hasn't fired this time in but should be improved out to 2400m now.
